globalProofStillRequired: DB00/native-SQL/detached-consumer sweep must find no current producer/reader of either table.
Read-only live legacy metadata, if obtained, may show rows/tables but existence alone is not active-use proof.
DB19 final field disposition must approve the redesign/retirement before DONE_VERIFIED.
